claim_check: Conservative pattern match; a flagged phrase passes only if the same words (or a simple plural/singular) appear in the supplied facts or reviews. It blocks claims the input never mentions; it does not prove any claim true. Human review required.

honesty: Testimonials are verbatim prefixes of reviews supplied by the business, with the author and rating as supplied; ReviewForge cannot verify that a supplied review is genuine. Marketing copy (hero/services/about) is LLM- or template-generated and is rejected if it asserts a credential, award, offer, guarantee or statistic the supplied business data and reviews do not mention. Every image is listed above with its origin; any image not supplied by the business is flagged illustrative, kept out of the work gallery, carries neutral alt text and no ownership caption, and is disclosed in the page footer. Generated image files are written without embedded generation metadata; those details are recorded here instead.
